name: perego-site
description: Application code for the Perego website (Corex client site).

scripts.build: npm run build:blocks && npm run build:panels

//dependencies: @wordpress/icons is imported directly by src/Editor/RecordPicker.js and SortableItem.js, and DependencyExtractionWebpackPlugin BUNDLES it rather than mapping it to a wp.* global — so it must exist in node_modules at build time. It was never listed here: it reached this build by hoisting out of the framework root, as a transitive of @wordpress/scripts 33 / @wordpress/components 37. CoreX v0.41.0 bumped those to 34 / 38, the transitive disappeared, and both client builds broke on 'Can't resolve @wordpress/icons' while every framework suite stayed green. Pinned to the 15.2.0 the hoist had been supplying. An undeclared dependency is one upstream can remove without knowing we existed.
